# SperaCode (سبيرا كود)

> SperaCode (سبيرا كود) is a premier Egypt-based software development agency and digital product studio. The company specializes in building high-performance web applications, iOS and Android mobile apps, interactive digital QR menus for hospitality, custom AI and chatbot integrations, and human-centered UI/UX design. SperaCode operates remotely, serving businesses and startups across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Qatar, the MENA region, and globally in both Arabic and English.

## Verified Company Facts

- **Headquarters**: Egypt (operates remotely across the Middle East and worldwide)
- **Official Languages**: Arabic (العربية) and English
- **Canonical Website**: https://speracode.com
- **Public Figures**: 50+ projects delivered, 45+ enterprise & SME clients served, 6+ years of specialized industry experience.
- **Client Satisfaction**: 4.9/5 average rating based on verified customer reviews.
- **Client Ownership**: 100% intellectual property and full source code ownership transfers to the client upon final settlement.
- **Support Policy**: Complimentary post-launch warranty and technical support included with every project, with optional monthly/annual SLA maintenance agreements.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Web Development (تطوير المواقع والمنصات)
- Custom corporate websites, landing pages, and web portals.
- Modern e-commerce platforms with fast checkout, payment gateway integrations, and product management.
- Scalable SaaS applications and internal management dashboards.
- Tech stack: Next.js (React 19), TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase.

### 2. Mobile Applications (تطبيقات الجوال)
- Native-grade mobile applications for iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android.
- Cross-platform development using Flutter and React Native for unified performance and faster time-to-market.
- Real-time notifications, location services, offline capabilities, and secure API synchronization.

### 3. Digital QR Menus for Restaurants & Cafés (المنيو الرقمي QR)
- Interactive, responsive digital restaurant menus accessed via QR code scans without downloading any app.
- Full bilingual Arabic & English support with real-time price and item management.
- Direct-to-WhatsApp ordering system that minimizes printing overhead and wait times.

### 4. Artificial Intelligence & Automation Solutions (حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي والأتمتة)
- Custom AI chatbots for 24/7 customer support trained on company knowledge.
- Business process automation, CRM synchronization, and LLM API integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic).
- Intelligent document processing and generative assistants.

### 5. UI/UX Product Design (تصميم واجهات وتجربة المستخدم)
- Human-centered research, user journey mapping, and wireframing.
- Modern high-fidelity UI design in Figma with interactive clickable prototypes and comprehensive design systems.
- Accessibility-compliant, responsive interfaces tailored for conversion.

### 6. Maintenance, Support & Cloud Infrastructure
- Continuous monitoring, bug triage, security audits, and speed optimization.
- Corporate email setup, domain registration, SSL certificates, and cloud hosting management (Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare).

## Typical Project Timeline & Pricing Model
- **Corporate & Portfolio Websites**: 1–3 weeks.
- **Custom Web Platforms & E-Commerce**: 4–8 weeks.
- **Mobile Applications**: 6–10 weeks.
- **Digital QR Menus**: 2–5 days deployment.
- **Pricing**: Transparent, milestone-based quotes provided upfront after technical discovery, without hidden charges.
